name: blea
description: Universal Agent Plugin for safe BLE diagnostics and automation via Skill, CLI, and MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Safe BLE diagnostics and automation for AI agents.
interface.longDescription: BLEA is a universal BLE Agent Plugin that combines a safety-aware Skill, deterministic CLI, local MCP server, and portable capture/diff/replay evidence workflows. Live writes require explicit authorization and exact device confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose my Bluetooth adapter and scan for nearby BLE devices.
Capture and compare two read-only BLE evidence packages.
Replay a BLE evidence package without connecting to hardware.
